_comment: GOLDEN-305, 30 epoch, ALL-FREQUENCY CONTROL — the matched baseline for
_golden305_gps_30ep_dual.json.  Identical in every respect (303 in-network GPS-only,
channel_mode single, lane_carry OFF, full golden instrumentation, WTZZ00DEU closed-loop
consumer, 30 epochs = 900 s) EXCEPT processing.frequency_mode, which stays at the golden
posture's 'all'.  Single knob, matched duration, own lineage.
WHY THIS EXISTS: the only ALL-frequency 305 measurement on hand (_golden305_gps_30m,
median settled 34871 ms) ran CONCURRENTLY with a sibling 305 job holding roughly half the
20-thread box, while the dual probe (median settled 25391 ms) had the machine to itself.
The naive 1.37x is therefore NOT the dual speedup.  The giveaway is assembly-wall: 2127 ms
contended vs 1122 ms clean, and assembly is only weakly band-dependent — most of that gap
is contention.  This arm re-measures ALL on a clean box so the dual-vs-all comparison is
made on equal footing.
RUN IT ALONE.  A second 305 job on this machine invalidates the entire point of the arm;
that is the confound it exists to remove.  Check for other gnss_processor* processes
before launching and grade on D0/D0b section medians over settled epochs, never on wall.
STRUCTURAL EXPECTATION (band-driven, contention-independent — these should hold whatever
the timing says): shared cols 566 (all) vs 499 (dual); n_cb 130-ish (all) vs 102 (dual).
The dual reduction is modest because the shared block also carries satellite clocks and
the 256 deg-15 SH-VTEC coefficients, neither of which depends on band count.
⚠️ DO NOT try to reach a 'conformant two-frequency producer' by setting
network.estimate_sat_code_bias: false — it is SILENTLY FORCED BACK ON.
GnssConfigLoadNetwork.cpp:2034 does `if (estimate_network_iono_sh_) {
estimate_network_sat_code_bias_ = true; }` AFTER parsing the user value, with no warning.
The co-estimated SH-VTEC field IS the constraint that makes the satellite DCB observable
against the per-(rx,sat) slant iono (loader comment, same file ~2017-2022: 'a single
coupled slice ... must ALL be present or the shared null-space rank gate withholds every
epoch').  Disabling satellite OSB therefore requires disabling network.estimate_iono_sh,
which the standing directive forbids (SH-VTEC-always-on is a DATUM, not a nicety).
That coupling is the same GF-combination / ionosphere absorption Odijk 2016 describes —
it shows up here as an inseparability, not as a rank wall.
FRESH LINEAGE ONLY.  Own paths; never resume onto another arm's snapshot.
